findings.title: Clean-state desktop first-launch blocked: .setup() auto-starts daemon unconditionally; daemon exits 'No active creator'; wizard has no creator-bootstrap invoke
findings.note: Pre-existing product/arch gap exposed by V1.97 smoke (spawn-name fix made daemon reachable). V1.97 ships the spawn-name fix; creator-bootstrap design deferred. Needs architect: gate daemon auto-start behind setup_completed + wizard creator-init. QC source: §R-V197-SMOKE-CLEAN-STATE
findings.closure_note: Closed by V1.100 P0 — interactive macOS clean-state smoke: user confirmed daemon reached 'Daemon is running' after wizard bootstrap; No active creator blocker resolved. ensure_setup_bootstrap + .setup() gating shipped.

findings.title: Full desktop UI smoke (clean-state + existing-install wizard observation) requires interactive macOS host; headless session cannot drive native Tauri window
findings.note: Attach path + unit tests verified; wizard/UI flow not. Manual or automated desktop smoke on interactive host in V1.98. QC source: §R-V197-SMOKE-UI
findings.closure_note: Closed by V1.100 P0 — clean-state interactive macOS smoke captured (user: daemon reached running). Existing-install path is byte-for-byte code-preserved (QC1/QC2 verified .setup() true-branch) + clean-state smoke confirmed daemon reachability. User chose to continue rather than run a separate existing-install pass; UI polish findings registered as separate residuals.
